component.name: curfewd
component.summary: Screen time limits, curfews, and per-app timers for Linux

description.p: curfewd is a modern Linux screen-time enforcement daemon and Material Design 3 desktop application. Manage daily allowances, allowed hours, curfews, and individual per-app daily timers without running the graphical interface as root.

Includes verified multi-DE screen locking (Cinnamon, GNOME, KDE, XFCE, MATE), non-destructive fullscreen game lock compatibility, one-click lock-screen hardening, and a passwordless My Screen Time view for standard users.
Replaced legacy tray padlock icons with Material Design 3 Twilight Guard squircle + shield + crescent-moon status variants matching curfewd-ui.
Fixed installed application scanner to follow exported Flatpak .desktop symlinks and unwrap sh -c Steam launchers.
Fixed mainloop-free D-Bus client connections, stale 0.6.x service symlink cleanup during upgrades, and systemd unit StartLimit placement.
First 1.0 release with native Material Design 3 desktop UI, Today-only overrides, individual per-app daily limits, and one-click lock-screen protection.
